senses.zh: n.泡 泡沫 气泡 幻想 骗局 欢乐 vi.冒泡 沸腾 起泡 出现 洋溢 vt.使冒泡

ex.en: As we all know, cultural or individual differences in personal bubble diameters are all too often the cause of discomfort.
ex.zh: 众所周知，文化差异或个人差异会影响所需的个人空间大小，而这些差异往往会让人感到不适。

ex.en: While excessive optimism can promote bad investment patterns, resulting in a real-estate "bubble," the report's writers downplay that potential outcome in that it has not yet occurred.
ex.zh: 虽然过度乐观可能助长不良投资行为，导致房地产“泡沫”，但报告作者淡化了这种潜在后果，因为它尚未发生。

tip: bubble既指气泡，也可比喻资产价格泡沫。
